prompt:
Phimond desert map kit, SIX isolated landmark / prop sprites, 2 columns x3rows, flat exact #FF00FF, square1536. Reference1 ORIGINAL Shicheng map content authority for dome ruins, pale spiral rocks, cactus and giant bones. Images2 approved town facade and3 approved forest portal are STYLE only, match material richness and pixel clusters but do not copy their leafy or European design. Images4–5 pet anchors for outline/volume only. User authorizes new map-specific interpretations based on these observed motifs and map names.
Camera frontal billboard24deg above, all objects complete with48px margins and ≥64px separation; no labels, scene background, ground plane or cast shadows. These are separate modular game props.
Row1 LEFT — entrance landmark: two asymmetrical pale wind-carved spiral stone towers joined by one weathered natural stone lintel, OPEN gateway hole magenta. Bases broad and attached individually, mineral rust seams and eroded mauve shade; rough natural geology not built arch.
Row1 RIGHT — sealed land landmark: ancient circular stone seal disk standing upright in a low stepped sandstone plinth, cracked ring and three concentric engraved geometric channels, two distinct broken finials attached at sides. Dark inactive ochre/gray channels; no glow or letters/runes. Rust sandstone, worn bone ivory casing, cool mauve dark recesses. Unique design unlike entrance.
Row2 LEFT — Hulu tribe landmark: large nomad pavilion, weathered ochre and muted rust cloth canopy over stout wood poles, tied bundles and pale bone crossbeam. Two hanging round GOURD vessels prominent under eaves to distinguish Hulu; dark open doorway magenta. Sagging asymmetrical cloth and simple woven geometric trims, no script. All elements attached, no detached pegs.
Row2 RIGHT — barren sands landmark: ancient wind compass cairn, huge irregular weathered limestone lodestone on low broken radial sandstone ring, leaning split upright slab surrounded by three shorter attached jagged slabs; partially sand-buried foot. No actual floating sand disk, no glyphs. Ivory/gray stone, rust ochre and muted wood-brown mineral bands. Clearly different from doorway and seal.
Row3 LEFT — disaster sands landmark: broken rib-cage stone-and-bone monument, massive arched fossil ribs emerging through fractured red sandstone ruin pedestal, one snapped ivory skull fragment at base, dark mauve chasm opening INSIDE connected stone ring. All forms connected, complete silhouette, no scattered bits. Not a recolor of original monster skull; upright ribs define silhouette.
Row3 RIGHT — REPLACEMENT tall two-arm cactus: thick saguaro olive ribs and sage faces, all pale spine dots INSIDE the body only, smooth stepped silhouette NO exterior spikes. Complete fleshy root grips a small connected irregular base of rust sandstone and ivory mineral chunks with dark exposed woody roots, multiple materials balanced but no ground shadow. No flowers/detached dots. New drawing, not the previous cactus recolored.
Exact approved batch00–09 / Octopath-inspired HD2D pixel art, warm upper-left, cool shaded planes, dark same-hue outlines never black, deliberate clusters2–4tones per material, 33–48 detailed colors per object. Sand #D9B26B/#B88A44, rust #A5522B, ivory limestone, subdued gray-violet, olive and wood. No smooth painting/3D/dither/noise/gradient/fog/bloom, no half transparency. Visually rich enough to sit beside approved architecture.
